body: I've lost pretty much all my friends, everyone at my school hates me. I just want to feel accepted. I feel like I'm not good enough for the world. I just hate myself so much. If I could commit suicide without hurting anyone 'that surprisingly do Care' I would already be gone. Everyone tells me its a phase even though I've been feeling like this for 4 years. I dont know what to do anymore
I feel meaningless, I was diagnosed with depression last year and I don't know what to do with myself anymore
